ForgotPassword.title: Forgot my password
ForgotPassword.description: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.sentDescription: If there is an account for {email}, we sent a link to change the password. It is valid for one hour. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
ForgotPassword.resent: If there is an account for this address, a new link was sent.
ForgotPassword.genericError: We could not send the link right now. Please try again in a moment.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.passwordTooShort: The password needs at least 8 characters.
ResetPassword.weakPassword: This password does not meet the security rules. Try a longer one, mixing letters, numbers and symbols.
ResetPassword.genericError: We could not change the password right now. Please try again in a moment.
ResetPassword.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid
ResetPassword.invalidBody: The password reset link is valid for one hour and can only be used once. Ask for a new one to continue.
ResetPassword.doneBody: Your password was changed, and the sessions opened with the old password were closed. Sign in with the new password.
